2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the predecessor of the plaintiffs, Jannat Ali was the owner of 0.86 decimals of land which was recorded in C.S Khatian No.375 and R.S. Khatain No.509 and C.S. Plot Nos.1701 and 1980 and R.S. Plot Nos.1911 and 1792 of mouza Santosh under Police Station and District-Tangail; that the Jannat Ali had bebn owning and possessing 0.86 decimals of land on payment of rents and taxes to the Zamminder and after Acquisition of Zamminder paid rents to the Government; that while being in rightful possession Jannat Ali died leaving the plaintiffs as heirs to the land in suit and since then they have been owning and possessing the same; that during R.O.R. operation the land in suit was wrongly recorded in the names of the defendants who have no right, title and possession in the land in suit; that for the first time on 11.08.1988 corresponding to the last part of Chaitra, 1394 B.S. The plaintiffs came to learn from the concerned Tahsil Office about the said wrong records of right in the name of the defendants and since then the cause of action has arisen and hence the suit for declaration of title in the suit land. 

 3. The defendant contested the Other Class Suit No.88 of 1989 filling written statement contending, 'inter alia', that during the C.S. operation 0.86 decimals of land was recorded in the name of Jannat Ali, predecessors-in-interest of the plaintiffs in 16 (sixteen) annas share; that Profullah Kumar Sen as a Manager of the Court of Ward on behalf of the Zaminder Santosh Panch Ani filed a Rent Suit No.55 of 1942 in the 2nd Court of Munsif, Tangail and the suit was decreed on 26.03.1942 and subsequently the Execution Case No.133 of 1943 was started and in the said Execution Case land in suit was sold in auction which was purchased by Darog Ali who had been owning and possessing the same on payment of rent to the Government acquired estate; that earlier to the auction sale by the authority concerned and after the death of C.S. recorded tenant Jannat Ali his wife Rangbi Bewa who on her own behalf and on behalf of the minor son, Fatik Sk. and on behalf of her daughter Taluki Bibi sold 0.58 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No.1780 to the said Darog Ali by a registered kabla dated 20.12.1941 on consideration of TK.250.00; that thereafter, Sobhan SK. who is defendant No.1 purchase 0.58 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No.1780 from the said Darog Ali by a registered kabla dated 21.07.1943 at consideration of TK.300.00; that Sobhan SK. became owner of 0.58 decimals of land by way of kabla purchase; that the defendant No.2 took rayiati pattan of 0.28 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No.1701 on 23.02.1943; that in these way the defendants have became owner of the suit land; that the R.O.R. Khatian has been rightly prepared in the names of the defendants; that the plaintiffs have no title and possession therein; that the suit is barred by limitation; that the plaintiffs have filed the suit falsely and the suit is liable to be dismissed with cost.
